[[Yenniku]] (youngest son) }} '''Vol'jin''', son of [[Sen'jin]], is the chieftain of the [[Darkspear tribe]]. ==Quests== * {{questlong|Horde|10|Zalazane's Fall}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|31|To My Father, Vol'jin}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|45|Sandfury Redemption III}} {{questfinish}} * {{questlong|Horde|45|Of the Sandfury and the Darkspear}} {{queststart}} ==Quotes== ===Gossip=== I be Vol'jin, son of Sen'jin. It be a long time since we fled our lands of the Darkspear Isles, but here in Durotar we found a new home and future alongside the Horde. Our tribe be resilient, and no matter how the river flow, the stones remain. Stay away from the Voodoo, and may the Loa forever guide ya steps mon. For the Darkspear and for the Horde! ===On-click=== *Spirits be with you, stranger. How may I help? *You come to consult the spirits? *How can old Vol'jin help you? ===Aggro=== *You make big mistake, mon. *Here come the voodoo! *For the Darkspear tribe!
